data.name: Manoj Sathe
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Manoj Sathe has made a big mark in cricket. With 40 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 70*, with an average of 23.11 and a quick strike rate of 147.90. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 17 sixes and 98 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 2.0 overs, taking 2 wickets at an economy rate of 10.50. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
